messages:
deploy-bot: Starting release deploy to production · env=prod · tag=release-2026-03-20 · initiator=sam.p
deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Starting migration job: migrations/run_schema_upgrade --from schema_v12 --to schema_v13
ciara_ops: Change window approved for 03:00-05:00 UTC, we're inside it.
alexa.s: Copying release notes to /releases/release-2026-03-20.md and pinning runtime image to `rwd-inference:2026-03-20-rc1`
ben_qa: Noted. Any risky ALTERs in this batch?
sam.p: Two ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN and one index creation that takes locks — should be online, but monitor locks.
deploy-bot: Migration step 1/3: add_view_columns ... OK (duration: 12s)
deploy-bot: Migration step 2/3: create_index_user_activity ... STARTED
deploy-bot: ERROR: create_index_user_activity failed on shard db-prod-03
```
ERROR: could not obtain lock on relation "user_activity"
DETAIL:  Process 4821 holds a conflicting lock.
```
ciara_ops: Oof. That index was expected to be fast but looks blocked by a long-running analytics job.
alexa.s: Can we cancel analytics job and retry? Or should we rollback?
ben_qa: If we wait we might exceed change window. What's the time till window end?
ciara_ops: ~25 minutes. We could cancel analytics job (job id 4821) and retry index creation. If cancel fails, rollback is cleaner.
sam.p: Try cancel first. If it fails within 2m, initiate rollback.
ciara_ops: Cancelling job 4821 now: `SELECT pg_cancel_backend(4821);`
deploy-bot: pg_cancel_backend returned true for pid 4821
deploy-bot: Retrying create_index_user_activity ... STARTED
deploy-bot: create_index_user_activity ... OK (duration: 4m 8s)
deploy-bot: Migration step 3/3: backfill_activity_data ... STARTED
deploy-bot: backfill_activity_data progress: 10% (approx ETA 55m)
alexa.s: That backfill will exceed our change window. We should not block prod. Options: 1) Roll forward with backfill running async (risk: longer background IO); 2) Pause backfill and schedule off-window; 3) Rollback. Prefer option 2 and pin schema version. Thoughts?
ben_qa: Option 2 is safest. Pause backfill, create a ticket to resume off-window, and pin schema as partially-migrated state in release notes.
sam.p: Agree. Execute controlled pause and mark migration as 'deferred-backfill'.
ciara_ops: Pausing backfill via `migrations/control --pause backfill_activity_data --reason "change-window"`
deploy-bot: backfill_activity_data paused at 11% on db-prod-01 (operator=ciara_ops)
deploy-bot: Migration job finished with status: PARTIAL_SUCCESS (schema_v13 applied; backfill deferred)
alexa.s: Pinned release tag to `release-2026-03-20+deferred-backfill`. Added note in release notes: "Index created; background backfill paused at 11% — resumed in maintenance window 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC."
ben_qa: Will add a smoke-check to ensure no regressions from partial backfill.
oncall-bot: Incident/Change ticket created: CHG-2026-0417 by ciara_ops — backfill resume scheduled 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC
sam.p: Thanks everyone — deploying the pinned image and continuing with traffic. If anything degrades, we'll rollback to `release-2026-03-19` (previous tag). :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished to prod · tag=release-2026-03-20+deferred-backfill · status=completed · duration=00:18:27
